summary: Tests needing external APIs require a cloud alias naming the test plugin, like cloud/aws, cloud/azure or cloud/vcenter.
questions: What alias do AWS integration tests need?

answer_card.title: Cloud aliases
answer_card.answer_md: Add the cloud plugin alias, for example `cloud/aws`, `cloud/azure`, `cloud/cs`, `cloud/digitalocean`, `cloud/openshift`, `cloud/vcenter`.
